plugin_version: 0.3.0 development at 50408ca, before final v0.3.0 tag
execution_order: Rotate ABC/BCA/CAB by fixed task index
prices: No verified billing basis; dollar costs not computed
cache_write: Not independently observable; compatibility zero aliases are retained raw and not treated as native write measurements
preflight_note: The first nine official images are already cached from pilots. Remaining image downloads are timed once per task and shared across arms. Solve/evaluation do not include that shared preparation time.
jev_context_control: Atomic relevance and ownership at observed-input-calibrated pressure, with complete raw journals retained.
request_limit_enforcement: Observer admits at most 64 upstream model calls total, including every Jev batch and every native main/child/compaction DeepSeek call
thinking_note: All arms send thinking enabled and reasoning_effort high. The old fixed low provider override was removed from this dedicated Magpie connection.
workbuddy_session_binding_observation: Native session header was sent; returned x-wb-account labels still change on successive requests. Running service differs from newer on-disk binding implementation; shared service was not restarted.
solver_isolation: Internal Docker bridge; local relay to existing Magpie/observer only. Initial Git object store contains exactly base_commit/tree; no future refs, objects or reflog.
child_lifecycle: Native continuable children; cached identity survives completed activations.
selection: Two prespecified diagnostic tasks: 10051 (all arms solved, excess Auto output) and 7236 (Auto failed, controls solved). Chosen from prior results to investigate mechanisms, not estimate general improvement.
source_note: The corresponding working sources were exercised before these commits were created. The only subsequent plugin code normalization handles omitted effort lists; all trial profiles explicitly use high, so it does not alter these runs.
configuration_accounting: One saved compiled strategy is reused across tasks. Configuration probes are separately accounted in ../configuration-probes.json and ../probe-summary.json; not charged repeatedly to each task.
pressure_comparison_note: A calibrates pressure against observed input; B/C retain native estimated-pressure compaction at 0.1875. Any gain may reflect pressure engineering rather than Jev judgment; this is not an ablation against an independently calibrated native baseline.
